```{r Prepping, include=FALSE}

## Loading packages
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(tidyverse)


## Loading data
  # nest-level data for all cavities
nesting_os <- read_csv('data/nesting_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_meg <- read_csv('data/nesting_cleaned_megachile.csv') 
  # trapnest-level data
trapnesting_os <- read_csv('data/trapnesting_cleaned_osmia.csv')
trapnesting_meg <- read_csv('data/trapnesting_cleaned_megachile.csv')
  # cell-level data
nesting_cells_os <- read_csv('data/nesting_cells_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_cells_meg <- read_csv('data/nesting_cells_cleaned_megachile.csv')
  # nest-level data for investment measures
nesting_investment_os <- read_csv('data/investment_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_investment_meg <- read_csv('data/investment_cleaned_megachile.csv')


# number of nests
nesting_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(Bee_choice)) %>%
  summarize(nests_total = sum(Bee_choice)) # 167 osmia nests for osmia through the summer
nesting_meg %>%
  filter(!is.na(Bee_choice)) %>%
  summarize(nests_total = sum(Bee_choice)) # 140 megachile nests for osmia through the summer

# set theme
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 15))

library("RColorBrewer")
display.brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "Set2")
brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "Oranges")
display.brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "Blues")
brewer.pal(n = 9, name = "Blues")


```

```{r Simulations}


## Create the function to simulate data

# simulate the null hypothesis that bees are treating each cavity equally, thus nesting would be based just on availability
# simulation without replacement so that if there are multiple new osmia nests, the number of available cavities goes down by one for each sequential new nest in that subsite-group combo

# create a function to simulate the distribution of nests based on the null hypothesis that bees are nesting according to available cavities 
simulate_nests <- function(avail_cavities, total_nests) {
  n <- length(avail_cavities) # number of available cavities
  nest_counts <- rep(0, n) # start with zero nests in each trapnest

  # keep as zeros is no nests are built
  if (total_nests == 0) {
    return(nest_counts)
  }

  # look through each of the new nests to be randomly assigned
  for (i in 1:total_nests) {
    if (sum(avail_cavities) == 0) break  # stop if all cavities used
    probability <- avail_cavities / sum(avail_cavities) # calculate probability proportional to the number of available cavities
    chosen <- sample(1:n, size = 1, prob = probability) # randomly choose a trapnest for the new nest based on available cavities
    nest_counts[chosen] <- nest_counts[chosen] + 1 # record it
    avail_cavities[chosen] <- avail_cavities[chosen] - 1 # reduce the number of available cavities by 1, when we apply the function the loop will run again until no new nests are left
  }
  return(nest_counts) # return the vector with how many nests were randomly assigned
}

# indicate how many simulated data columns we want for the model
n_sim <- 100 


## Apply the function

trapnesting_os_null <- trapnesting_os %>%
  group_by(Subsite, Date) %>%
  group_modify(~ { # simulate random nest distribution for subsite-date combo
    for (i in 1:n_sim){ # make each of the columns we indicated that we want 
    nest_counts <- simulate_nests(.x$Available_cavities_prior, sum(.x$New_nests_os)) # use available cavities as weights and sum the new nests
    .x[[paste0('Null_new_nests', i)]] <- nest_counts # make the new column
    }
    .x # return the modified group
  }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


## Apply the function

trapnesting_meg_null <- trapnesting_meg %>%
  group_by(Subsite, Date) %>%
  group_modify(~ { # simulate random nest distribution for subsite-date combo
    for (i in 1:n_sim){ # make each of the columns we indicated that we want 
    nest_counts <- simulate_nests(.x$Available_cavities_prior, sum(.x$New_nests_meg)) # use available cavities as weights and sum the new nests
    .x[[paste0('Null_new_nests', i)]] <- nest_counts # make the new column
    }
    .x # return the modified group
  }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


```

## Congeneric Attraction

```{r Congeneric_Attraction}

# make df with average of simulated data

trapnesting_os_null <- trapnesting_os_null %>% mutate(Null_new_nests_mean = rowMeans(select(., Null_new_nests1:Null_new_nests100)))

trapnesting_os_fig_data <- trapnesting_os_null %>%
  select(Osmia_ps_prior, Null_new_nests_mean, New_nests_os) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Null_new_nests_mean, New_nests_os),
    names_to = "Data_type",
    values_to = "New_nests"
  )


ggplot(trapnesting_os_fig_data, aes(y = New_nests, x = Osmia_ps_prior, fill = Data_type)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("New_nests_os" = "#1b9e77",
                               "Null_new_nests_mean" = "#d95f02"))




trapnesting_os_fig_data <- trapnesting_os_null %>%
  select(Treatment, Null_new_nests_mean, New_nests_os) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Null_new_nests_mean, New_nests_os),
    names_to = "Data_type",
    values_to = "New_nests"
  )



trapnesting_os_fig_data_sum <- trapnesting_os_fig_data %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Data_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_new_nests = mean(New_nests, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_new_nests = sd(New_nests, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_new_nests = sd_new_nests / sqrt(n))



ggplot(trapnesting_os_fig_data_sum, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_new_nests, 
                            fill = Data_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_new_nests - se_new_nests, 
                    ymax = mean_new_nests + se_new_nests),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                width = 0.3) +
  labs(
    x = "Occupancy Treatment",
    y = "Average Number of New Nests",
    fill = "Data Type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("New_nests_os" = "#1b9e77",
                               "Null_new_nests_mean" = "#d95f02"),
                    labels = c("Observed", "Simulated")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

### check how the error bars were calculated

```

## Nesting per congeneric presence (including pseudo nests)

```{r Conspecifics_with_pseudo, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Probability

# create a probability by successes/ successes + failures
os_fig_data <- nesting_os_xs %>% mutate(Probability_new_nest = New_nests_os / Available_cavities_prior)

## Osmia

os_fig_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Osmia_ps_prior, y = Probability_new_nest)) +
  geom_jitter(colour = "goldenrod2", alpha = 0.5, height = 0.05, width = 0.1) +
  stat_smooth(method = "glm", colour = "goldenrod2", fill = "goldenrod2") +
  labs(x = "Number of " ~ italic(Osmia) ~ " in trapnest", y = "Number of new nests / \n Number of potential nests") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black")) +
  xlim(0, 18) +
  ylim(0, 1)



### Raw data

## Osmia

nesting_os_xs %>%
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_ps_prior, New_nests_os)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.5, colour = "steelblue2") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "indianred3", fill = "indianred3") +
  labs(x = "Osmia", y = "Number of new nests each visit") +
  xlim(0, 18)

## Megachile

nesting_meg_xs %>%
  ggplot(aes(Meg_ps_prior, New_nests_meg)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.5, colour = "goldenrod2") +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", colour = "indianred3", fill = "indianred3") +
  labs(x = "Available cavities", y = "Number of new nests each visit") +
  xlim(0, 18)
```

## Parasitism

```{r Wrangling Parasitism data, ignore=TRUE}
## Change data to make a stacked bar plot

cells_os <- pivot_longer(nesting_cells_os,
  cols = c(Sum_cell_not_parasitized, Sum_cell_parasitized),
  names_to = "Parasitized",
  values_to = "Cell_count"
)


cells_os$Parasitized <- factor(cells_os$Parasitized, levels = c("Sum_cell_parasitized", "Sum_cell_not_parasitized"))
```

```{r Parasitism, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Relation between parasites and aggregation densities, with pseudo

cells_os %>%
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_ps_no_iw, Cell_count, fill = Parasitized, colour = Parasitized)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + # to make this a proportion of cells, add "position='fill'"
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("plum", "seagreen3")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("plum", "seagreen3"))


# Relation between parasites and aggregation densities, without pseudo

cells_os %>%
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_no_ps_no_iw, Cell_count, fill = Parasitized, colour = Parasitized)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + # to make this a proportion of cells, add "position='fill'"
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("plum", "seagreen3")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("plum", "seagreen3"))


# Relation between parasites and aggregation densities, only unsealed

cells_os %>%
  ggplot(aes(Sum_unsealed_os_no_iw, Cell_count, fill = Parasitized, colour = Parasitized)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + # to make this a proportion of cells, add "position='fill'"
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato2", "goldenrod2"), labels = c("Parasitized", "Not Parasitized"), name = ("Cell status")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("tomato2", "goldenrod2"), labels = c("Parasitized", "Not Parasitized"), name = ("Cell status")) +
  labs(y = "Number of cells", x = "Number of active " ~ italic(Osmia) ~ " nests") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"))
```

```{r Preferences and Parasites}
# make proportion of new nests
nests_os_xs <- nesting_os_xs %>% mutate(Proportion_new_nests_os = New_nests_os / Available_cavities_prior)

# scale DP_os_prior
nests_os_xs$DP_os_scaled <- scale(nests_os_xs$DP_os_prior)

# make numeric
nests_os_xs$DP_os_scaled <- as.numeric(nests_os_xs$DP_os_scaled)

# make mean + and - 1 SD
nests_os_xs <- nests_os_xs %>%
  mutate(
    mean_DP_os_scaled = mean(DP_os_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DP_os_scaled = sd(DP_os_scaled, na.rm = TRUE),
    DP_os_category = case_when(
      DP_os_scaled < mean_DP_os_scaled - sd_DP_os_scaled ~ "Mean - 1 SD",
      DP_os_scaled > mean_DP_os_scaled + sd_DP_os_scaled ~ "Mean + 1 SD",
      TRUE ~ "Mean"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-mean_DP_os_scaled, -sd_DP_os_scaled) # Optionally remove the intermediate columns


mean(nests_os_xs$DP_os_scaled)



# How the presence of parasites effects nesting preferences, with pseudo

# With interaction

nests_os_xs %>%
  ggplot(aes(NDP_ps_os_prior, Proportion_new_nests_os, colour = DP_os_category, group = DP_os_category)) +
  geom_jitter(colour = "goldenrod2", height = 0.1, width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", aes(colour = DP_os_category, fill = DP_os_category)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("tomato3", "tomato"), name = ("Number of nests with \ndetectable parasites"), breaks = c("Mean + 1 SD", "Mean")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato3", "tomato"), name = ("Number of nests with \ndetectable parasites"), breaks = c("Mean + 1 SD", "Mean")) +
  labs(y = "Number of new nests / \n Number of potential nests", x = "Number of nests without \ndetectable parasites") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black")) +
  xlim(0, 18) +
  ylim(0, 1)


# Without interaction

nests_os_xs %>%
  ggplot(aes(DP_os_prior, Proportion_new_nests_os)) +
  geom_jitter(colour = "goldenrod2", height = 0.1, width = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", colour = "tomato2", fill = "tomato2") +
  labs(y = "Number of new nests / \n Number of potential nests", x = "Number of nests with detectable parasites") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black")) +
  xlim(0, 3.5) +
  ylim(0, 1)
```

The most recent figure shows osmia density of unsealed nests, but shows cumulative parasites and doesn't count the current nest

```{r Last Cell, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Is the last cell more likely to be parasitized?
cells_os$Last_cell <- as.factor(cells_os$Last_cell)


cells_os %>%
  ggplot(aes(Last_cell, Cell_count, fill = Parasitized, colour = Parasitized)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + # to make this a proportion of cells, add "position='fill'"
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tomato2", "goldenrod2"), labels = c("Parasitized", "Not Parasitized"), name = ("Cell status")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("tomato2", "goldenrod2"), labels = c("Parasitized", "Not Parasitized"), name = ("Cell status")) +
  labs(y = "Number of cells", x = "Cell position") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Not last cell", "Last cell")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"))
```

```{r Investment, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Editing data for figure

investment_os <- investment_os %>% mutate(Prop_filled = Filled_length / Straw_length)


# Investment into a nest if other active nests or the nest itself is parasitized


investment_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nest_parasitized)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(DP_os_prior, Prop_filled, fill = Nest_parasitized)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = binomial()),
    aes(colour = Nest_parasitized)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Nest_parasitized), 
    alpha = 0.7, width = 0.05, height = 0.01) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "tomato2"),
    labels = c("Not parasitized", "Parasitized"),
    name = "Nest status") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "tomato2"), labels = c("Not parasitized", "Parasitized"), name = "Nest status") +
  labs(y = "Proportion of focal nest filled with cells", x = "Number of surrounding nests with detectable parasites") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"))






inner_walls_os %>% 
  ggplot(aes(NDP_os_prior)) +
  geom_histogram()

inner_walls_meg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(NDP_meg_prior)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
